name: Feywood Ranger's Leathers
description: A Feywood ranger's layered leather armor — tanned from sanctioned hides (silverbough hart, Feywoodhorn stag, rootback elk) using elven processes that preserve flexibility across long service.
narrative_effects: Provides light-armor protection with the quieter motion elven field operation demands.
Often bears subtle house-marks or personal identifiers recognizable only to trained elven observers.
